svg.title: Intel Arc Pro B70 · dense 27B · resident 32K session · prefix-cache effect
svg.desc: Cold 32,640-token document ingest at 38.2 s TTFT followed by eight sequential follow-up turns at 2.6-4.9 s TTFT with 89.9-94.7 percent token reuse on a growing session.
svg.text: PI DOCUMENT SESSION · DENSE 27B · PREFIX-CACHE EFFECT
One document, eight questions: Pi reads it once, then remembers
Qwen3.6-27B GPTQ-INT4 · vLLM XPU · MTP4 · fp8 KV · prefix cache on · 230 W cap
EVERY LATER QUESTION REUSES IT · CLIENT TTFT
First question reads the whole document
You ask Pi 8 questions over one 32K document: the first reads it all (38.2 s),
every follow-up reuses the cache (~4 s) as the session grows.
How much of each prompt is known
89.9-94.7% of every follow-up prompt is cache hits —
only the new question + reply are processed.
Cache speeds up reading the question, not generating the answer —
decode is flat at 41-56 t/s (MTP4, g128).
32,640-TOKEN DOCUMENT · MTP4 · G128 · PREFIX CACHE ON · 230 W
Client TTFT = request send to first SSE token · post-first = (completion-1)/(end-first) · cache matches in 64-token blocks.
